title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 12
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q111_bode_well
elements.title: A successful trial and strong demand ___ for the launch next month.

elements.name: q112_sweeping
elements.title: The proposal calls for ___ reforms that would change nearly every department.

elements.name: q113_bear_the_brunt
elements.title: Because they were closest to the river, the homes on Mill Street ___ of the flood damage: no other street was hit as hard.

elements.name: q114_unfold
elements.title: The documentary follows events as they ___, from the first meeting to the final vote.

elements.name: q115_pave_the_way
elements.title: The successful pilot could ___ for similar projects by removing doubts about the design.

elements.name: q116_cartel
elements.title: In business reporting, what is a “cartel”?
choices: A group of shoppers comparing prices
A group of companies coordinating to keep prices high
elements.correctAnswer: A group of companies coordinating to keep prices high

elements.name: q117_in_jeopardy
elements.title: The funding cuts put the project in ___. It may have to be cancelled.

elements.name: q118_arsenal
elements.title: “The tutor has an arsenal of teaching techniques.” What does “arsenal” mean here?
choices: A collection of methods the tutor can draw on
A rule forbidding certain teaching methods
A record of all the classes the tutor has taught
A penalty for failing to learn quickly
elements.correctAnswer: A collection of methods the tutor can draw on

elements.name: q119_the_science_behind
elements.title: The programme explains ___ bread rising by showing how yeast produces gas.

elements.name: q120_taint
elements.title: A bitter aftertaste can ___ an otherwise enjoyable meal.
